pli-tv-bu-vb-pc71:1.1: tena samayena buddho bhagavā kosambiyaṃ viharati ghositārāme.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc71:1.2: tena kho pana samayena āyasmā channo anācāraṃ ācarati.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc71:1.7: “na tāvāhaṃ āvuso, etasmiṃ sikkhāpade sikkhissāmi yāva na aññaṃ bhikkhuṃ vyattaṃ vinayadharaṃ paripucchāmī”ti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc71:1.8: ye te bhikkhū appicchā …pe… te ujjhāyanti khīyanti vipācenti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc71:1.9: “kathaṃ hi nāma āyasmā channo bhikkhūhi sahadhammikaṃ vuccamāno evaṃ vakkhati,
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc71:1.10: na tāvāhaṃ, āvuso etasmiṃ sikkhāpade sikkhissāmi yāva na aññaṃ bhikkhuṃ vyattaṃ vinayadharaṃ paripucchāmī”ti. …pe…
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc71:1.11: saccaṃ kira tvaṃ channa, bhikkhūhi sahadhammikaṃ vuccamāno evaṃ vadesi.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc71:1.12: “na tāvāhaṃ āvuso, etasmiṃ sikkhāpade sikkhissāmi yāva na aññaṃ bhikkhuṃ vyattaṃ vinayadharaṃ paripucchāmī”ti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc71:1.15: kathaṃ hi nāma tvaṃ moghapurisa, bhikkhūhi sahadhammikaṃ vuccamāno evaṃ vakkhasi,
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc71:1.16: “na tāvāhaṃ āvuso, etasmiṃ sikkhāpade sikkhissāmi yāva na aññaṃ bhikkhuṃ vyattaṃ vinayadharaṃ paripucchāmī”ti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc71:1.18: evañca pana bhikkhave, imaṃ sikkhāpadaṃ uddiseyyātha:
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc71:1.19.1: “yo pana bhikkhu bhikkhūhi sahadhammikaṃ vuccamāno evaṃ vadeyya na tāvāhaṃ āvuso, etasmiṃ sikkhāpade sikkhissāmi yāva na aññaṃ bhikkhuṃ vyattaṃ vinayadharaṃ paripucchāmīti pācittiyaṃ.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc71:1.20: sikkhamānena bhikkhave, bhikkhunā aññātabbaṃ paripucchitabbaṃ paripañhitabbaṃ. ayaṃ tattha sāmīcī”ti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc71:2.1.8: yaṃ bhagavatā paññattaṃ sikkhāpadaṃ etaṃ sahadhammikaṃ nāma.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc71:2.1.9: tena vuccamāno. evaṃ vadeyyāti: na tāvāhaṃ āvuso, etasmiṃ sikkhāpade sikkhissāmi yāva na aññaṃ bhikkhuṃ vyattaṃ vinayadharaṃ paripucchāmīti paṇḍitaṃ vyattaṃ medhāviṃ bahussutaṃ dhammakathikaṃ paripucchāmīti bhaṇati āpatti pācittiyassa.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc71:2.2.1: upasampanne upasampannasaññī evaṃ vadeti āpatti pācittiyassa.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc71:2.2.2: upasampanne vematiko evaṃ vadeti āpatti pācittiyassa.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc71:2.2.3: upasampanne anupasampannasaññī evaṃ vadeti, āpatti pācittiyassa.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc71:2.2.5: idaṃ na sallekhāya na dhutāya na pāsādikatāya na apacayāya na viriyārambhāya saṃvattatīti evaṃ vadeti “na tāvāhaṃ āvuso, etasmiṃ sikkhāpade sikkhissāmi yāva na aññaṃ bhikkhuṃ vyattaṃ vinayadharaṃ paṇḍitaṃ medhāviṃ bahussutaṃ dhammakathikaṃ paripucchāmī”ti bhaṇati āpatti dukkaṭassa.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc71:2.2.6: anupasampannena paññattena vā apaññattena vā vuccamāno
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc71:2.2.7: idaṃ na sallekhāya na dhutāya na pāsādikatāya na apacayāya na viriyārambhāya saṃvattatīti evaṃ vadeti, “na tāvāhaṃ āvuso, etasmiṃ sikkhāpade sikkhissāmi yāva na aññaṃ bhikkhu, vyattaṃ vinayadharaṃ paṇḍitaṃ medhāviṃ bahussutaṃ dhammakathikaṃ paripucchāmī”ti bhaṇati āpatti dukkaṭassa.
